name: pikku-review
description: Adversarial review of Pikku code against the gold standard: every function, workflow, agent and generated route in scope read in full and given a gold, fix or bug verdict with evidence. TRIGGER when: asked to review, audit, critique or scrutinize a Pikku diff, function, wiring, workflow or app, to say whether code is gold standard, or to check code before it merges or ships. DO NOT TRIGGER for: writing or fixing the code (review only reports), a non-technical second opinion (use pikku-software-archaeology), or reporting a bug in Pikku itself (use pikku-report).
